messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that generates and solves mazes with step-by-step visualization.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Generates maze using recursive division algorithm
- Solves maze using A* search algorithm
- Step-by-step visualization of both generation and solving process
- Visual indicators for different states (walls, paths, current search, solution)
- No external libraries, works in most browsers
- Clean, efficient code with proper error handling

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function runMaze(canvasId){const sleep=d=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,d));try{const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!canvas)throw new Error("Canvas not found");const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");if(!ctx)throw new Error("2D context not available");const size=500;canvas.width=size;canvas.height=size;const rows=25,cols=25;const cellSize=size/cols;const grid=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array(cols).fill(0));function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,size,size);for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){let v=grid[y][x];let color="#fff";if(v===1)color="#000";else if(v==="open")color="#6cf";else if(v==="closed")color="#999";else if(v==="current")color="#f00";else if(v==="path")color="#0c0";ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fillRect(x*cellSize,y*cellSize,cellSize,cellSize);}}}function randInt(min,max){return Math.floor(Math.random()*(max-min+1))+min;}async function divide(x,y,w,h,orientation){if(w<2||h<2)return;if(!orientation){orientation=w>h?"V":h>w?"H":Math.random()<0.5?"V":"H";}if(orientation==="H"){let hy=randInt(y+1,y+h-2);let passageX=randInt(x,x+w-1);for(let i=x;i<x+w;i++)grid[hy][i]=1;grid[hy][passageX]=0;draw();await sleep(30);await divide(x,y,w,h,hy-y>h-(hy-y)?"V":"H");await divide(x,hy+1,w,h-(hy-y+1),hy-y>h-(hy-y)?"V":"H");}else{let vx=randInt(x+1,x+w-2);let passageY=randInt(y,y+h-1);for(let i=y;i<y+h;i++)grid[i][vx]=1;grid[passageY][vx]=0;draw();await sleep(30);await divide(x,y,w,vx-x,orientation==="V"?"V":"H");await divide(vx+1,y,w-(vx-x+1),h,orientation==="V"?"V":"H");}}async function generate(){await divide(0,0,cols,rows,null);grid[1][1]=0;grid[rows-2][cols-2]=0;draw();}function heuristic(a,b){return Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+Math.abs(a.y-b.y);}async function solve(){const start={x:1,y:1},goal={x:cols-2,y:rows-2};let openSet=[{x:start.x,y:start.y,g:0,f:heuristic(start,goal),parent:null}];let closedSet=new Set();while(openSet.length){openSet.sort((a,b)=>a.f-b.f);let current=openSet.shift();if(current.x===goal.x&&current.y===goal.y){let node=current;while(node){grid[node.y][node.x]="path";node=node.parent;draw();await sleep(20);}return;}grid[current.y][current.x]="current";draw();await sleep(20);grid[current.y][current.x]="closed";closedSet.add(current.y+','+current.x);let neighbors=[[0,1],[1,0],[-1,0],[0,-1]];for(let [dx,dy] of neighbors){let nx=current.x+dx,ny=current.y+dy;if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=cols||ny>=rows)continue;if(grid[ny][nx]===1)continue;if(closedSet.has(ny+','+nx))continue;let gScore=current.g+1;let existing=openSet.find(n=>n.x===nx&&n.y===ny);if(!existing||gScore<existing.g){let h=heuristic({x:nx,y:ny},goal);let node={x:nx,y:ny,g:gScore,f:gScore+h,parent:current};if(!existing)openSet.push(node);else{existing.g=gScore;existing.f=gScore+h;existing.parent=current;}}}draw();await sleep(10);}draw();}await generate();await solve();}catch(e){console.error(e);}}
